text:
You need someone who can integrate OpenAI’s ChatGPT API into your web and business applications, keep the chatbot reliable, and work closely with your team to turn client requirements into a working solution.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building production web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’m comfortable working independently, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and taking features from implementation through deployment.

A relevant example of my work was the Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group. I built a Node.js queue with BullMQ and Redis that renders owner statements to PDF overnight with Puppeteer and stores them in AWS S3 instead of generating them on request. That shift supported 12k statements a month and took request timeouts from daily to none. While this was not an AI project, it required careful backend design, reliable automation, and a focus on operational stability—qualities that matter when building chatbot workflows and API-driven systems.

Another example is the End-to-end test suite I built for Kestrel Insurance. I created browser tests for the broker quoting flow using Playwright, GitHub Actions, Docker, and TypeScript, and set them to run on every pull request. The suite covered 160 tests and reduced release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1. That experience is relevant to chatbot and AI integration work because it reflects the kind of discipline needed to keep a product dependable as requirements evolve.

For your project, I’d focus on clean integration, maintainable code, and a setup that can be supported over time. I’m used to working with web applications and deployment, and I’d be comfortable collaborating with your team to understand the client’s business needs and translate them into a practical chatbot solution.

I’d be glad to share my resume and portfolio as requested. What part of the ChatGPT integration is the highest priority right now: the API connection, the chatbot logic, or deployment into your existing application?
